units.source_text: 他站在纸槅扇旁，看着一位穿白色手术衣的助产士给婴儿洗澡。

en.t: He stood beside the paper sliding screen, watching a midwife in a white surgical gown bathe the baby.

units.source_text: 每当肥皂流进眼里，婴儿就可爱地反复蹙起眉头，还不停的大声哭。

en.t: Whenever soap ran into its eyes, the baby adorably wrinkled its brow again and again, and kept crying loudly.

units.source_text: 他既觉得婴儿的味道有点像小鼠崽，又不由得深刻地想道：“为什么这婴儿也出生了呢？

en.t: He thought the baby smelled a little like a newborn mouse, and at the same time could not help thinking deeply, "Why was this baby born too?

units.source_text: 生到这个充满苦难的世界上来。

en.t: Born into this world filled with suffering.

units.source_text: ——为什么他要以我这样的人当爸爸呢？”

en.t: Why did he have to have someone like me as his father?"
